msg: Handsontable key 'non-commercial-and-evaluation' covers non-commercial use and evaluation only; Handsontable is proprietary since 7.0.0.
fix: Load a purchased Handsontable key from config, or pin handsontable 6.2.2 (the last MIT release).

msg: Handsontable is imported but this file sets no licenseKey; since 7.0.0 every instance needs a commercial key or the evaluation key.
fix: Pass licenseKey from your config (purchased key) to every Handsontable instance.

msg: FullCalendar Premium key 'GPL-My-Project-Is-Open-Source' is only valid when your whole project is released under the GPL.
fix: Buy a FullCalendar Premium licence and set schedulerLicenseKey from config, or drop the premium plugins.

msg: FullCalendar Premium key 'CC-Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives' forbids commercial use.
fix: Buy a FullCalendar Premium licence and set schedulerLicenseKey from config.

msg: A FullCalendar Premium plugin is imported but this file sets no schedulerLicenseKey.
fix: Set schedulerLicenseKey from config (purchased key) in the calendar options.

msg: TinyMCE license_key 'gpl' declares GPLv2+ use; TinyMCE 7.0 and later are GPLv2+ unless you hold a commercial key.
fix: Use a commercial TinyMCE key from config, the Tiny Cloud apiKey, or pin tinymce 6.8.x (MIT).

msg: TinyMCE is loaded but this file sets no license_key or apiKey; self-hosted TinyMCE 7+ asks for a commercial key or license_key 'gpl'.
fix: Set license_key from config (commercial key) or use the Tiny Cloud apiKey.

msg: CKEditor 5 licenseKey 'GPL' declares GPL 2+ use of the editor inside this product.
fix: Set a commercial CKEditor licenseKey from config, or ship the product under a GPL-compatible licence.

msg: CKEditor 5 is imported but this file sets no licenseKey; since v44.0.0 config.licenseKey is required.
fix: Set licenseKey from config: your commercial key, or 'GPL' only for GPL-licensed products.

msg: AG Grid Enterprise is imported but this file never calls setLicenseKey; Enterprise is paid per developer ($999 perpetual per developer, AG Grid list price).
fix: Call LicenseManager.setLicenseKey(<key from config>) before the first grid renders, or use ag-grid-community only.

msg: An MUI X Pro/Premium package is imported but this file never calls LicenseInfo.setLicenseKey.
fix: Call LicenseInfo.setLicenseKey(<key from config>) at app start, or switch to the MIT @mui/x-* package.

msg: A Syncfusion package is imported but this file never calls registerLicense; the free Community licence needs under $1M revenue, 5 or fewer developers and 10 or fewer employees.
fix: Call registerLicense(<key from config>) at app start with a paid or Community key.

msg: mapbox-gl 2.0.0 and later are proprietary (Mapbox Terms of Service, billed per map load); 1.13 was the last BSD-3 release.
fix: Keep a Mapbox account and budget map loads, or move to maplibre-gl (BSD-3 fork of 1.13).

msg: The npm package dhtmlx-gantt is the Standard edition under GPLv2.
fix: Buy a DHTMLX Gantt commercial licence and install the commercial build, or ship under the GPL.

msg: Highcharts is free for personal, school and non-profit use only; a commercial product needs a Highcharts licence.
fix: Record the Highcharts licence number for this product, or move to an MIT/Apache chart library.
